name: Again ~Saikai no Machikado~
source:
Main character receives an anonymous letter saying "I want to see you".  According to the mark, the sender is someone who lives in Hakodate, the town of his childhood. There were three girls he was particularly close to. He takes the plane to chase his love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角收到一封匿名信，上面寫著：「我想見你。」從信上的標記來看，寄信人住在函館——那座承載著他童年回憶的城市。他在那裡有三位關係尤其親密的女孩。為了追尋自己的愛情，他登上了前往函館的飛機。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
